title: PixtoLearn WOW day production plan
goal: Create a large volume of WOW specs + legacy art + cast seeds across Wave 1 and into Wave 2 while the operator is away.
operating_rules: One pack complete (cover + objects + actions installed + audit) before starting the next pack art.
One pack per sport (kit through finish). No new -prep/-activity sport pairs.
Gender: one pack + boy/girl casts. Never duplicate football-boy/football-girl packs.
Objects: single object, white bg, no person. Actions: locked avatar + outfit.
Install with install_art.py fill 0.72 into support + routines-generator card dirs.
After each pack: audit_art_quality.py; mark art installed / status ready; sync Parents.
Casts: seed boy from legacy, then girl cast batch. Do not block Wave 2 specs on casts finishing.
pipeline_per_pack: 1. Confirm/lock JSON spec (already done for Wave 1)
6. Flip pack JSON art fields to installed; routines.json status ready
8. Optional same day: seed-boy cast + queue girl casts

day_blocks.target_hours: first large chunk of the day

packs_in_order.why: Self-care base; public-toilet hands off to it
Community access; reuse soap/dryer visual language

day_blocks.done_when: Wave 1 packs legacy art installed (washing-hands, public-toilet, football, at-the-optician), audited, Parents synced

day_blocks.target_hours: after Block A or interleaved per pack
work: seed teen-boy-medium from legacy for each Wave 1 pack
claim/complete girl casts in batches of 6-8
day_blocks.done_when: Boy+girl casts present for covers + schedule actions of Wave 1

day_blocks.block: C - Wave 2 specs (parallelizable with cast work)
day_blocks.target_hours: mid/late day if Block A finishing
day_blocks.done_when: JSON specs registered in routines.json like Wave 1 (spec-ready, art todo)

day_blocks.block: D - Wave 2 art stretch (if time remains)
day_blocks.done_when: As many legacy packs installed as time allows; never leave a pack half-installed without notes

volume_targets.minimum_success: Wave 1 all 5 packs legacy art + Parents sync
volume_targets.strong_day: Wave 1 art + casts started + Wave 2 specs written
volume_targets.excellent_day: Wave 1 art+casts + Wave 2 specs + at least 2 Wave 2 packs legacy art

qa_gates: No MD5 duplicates inside a pack
Same avatar outfit across all actions of a pack
Prep packs end at ready; Activity packs do not redo full kit-on story
UTF-8 labels; no em dashes in docs
do_not_do_today: Regenerating unrelated shipped packs unless broken
note_unify: Sports prep/activity split reversed; portal shows one sports family.
